moods.name: Calm
moods.modifier: Mood: calm, meditative — reduce visual noise.

moods.name: Bold
moods.modifier: Mood: bold — stronger contrast, clearer hierarchy.

moods.name: Minimal
moods.modifier: Mood: minimal — fewer elements, more ma (negative space).

moods.name: Rich
moods.modifier: Mood: rich — allow subtle texture and depth.

aesthetics.name: Wabi-Sabi Neutral
aesthetics.culturalContext: Embrace imperfection and simplicity. Muromachi-era tea room sensibility — weathered, quiet, unforced.
aesthetics.styleDescription: Muromachi minimalism — no gradients, no shadows above 1px. Let negative space lead.

aesthetics.name: Shinto Ceremonial
aesthetics.culturalContext: Vermillion (torii), white (purity), gold (sacred). Shrine and ritual — clear hierarchy, ceremonial presence.
aesthetics.styleDescription: Shinto ceremonial — vermillion accents on white, gold for emphasis. Clean edges, no blur.

aesthetics.name: Edo Ink
aesthetics.culturalContext: Sumi-e monochrome. Ink wash and paper — gradations of black and grey, brush rhythm.
aesthetics.styleDescription: Edo ink — monochrome only. No color accents. Use opacity and weight for hierarchy.

aesthetics.name: Sakura Season
aesthetics.culturalContext: Spring pastels — blossom pink, new leaf, pale sky. Hanami and renewal.
aesthetics.styleDescription: Sakura season — soft pinks and greens, no harsh contrast. Gradients allowed if subtle.

aesthetics.name: Yoru (Night)
aesthetics.culturalContext: Night — deep indigo, paper white, lantern warmth. Quiet and contemplative.
aesthetics.styleDescription: Yoru — deep indigo base, paper-white text. One warm accent (lantern). No bright white flash.
